statement: let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let Q₂ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)/((Nat.log 2 (n+2):ℝ)^4)⌋₊; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Q₁ n < Q₂ n ∧ 2*(256*Q₂ n*Q n)*Q₂ n < n

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 特征与分母扩窗 · CW-8007 · 核验扩带后的分母增长和 Farey 分离尺度
plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8007 · Verify growth and Farey separation at the extended cutoff

brief.zh: 两端取整后比较 n^(1/6) 与对数四次幂。分离式的比值至多 512/log₂(n+2)^6，可用分数间距逐弧积分。
brief.en: After flooring compare n^(1/6) to the fourth power of the logarithm. The separation ratio is at most 512/log₂(n+2)^6, which permits termwise arc integration.
